title: Groomed Bead
description: Canonical shape for a groomed bead in the file-emit fallback used when the `bd` CLI is unavailable. One JSON object per line in a .jsonl file. These field and edge names are AUTHORITATIVE — do not improvise alternatives. In particular: the dependency array is `dependencies` (not `deps`), the identifier is `id` (not `slug`), and parentage is expressed as a dependency of type `parent` (there is no top-level `parent` field). `additionalProperties: false` enforces this.

id.description: Stable bead id, or a provisional slug when bd hasn't assigned one yet (e.g. sw-a1, notif-epic).

priority.description: Canonical priority is an integer 0 (critical) .. 4 (backlog). Write 1, not "P1".

grooming_status.description: Grooming outcome. Absent means ready. blocked-* beads are intentionally exempt from the design/acceptance/model requirements below, because they are flagged for the author rather than dispatched.

description.description: Immutable problem statement. Must be self-contained (fresh-agent test). If it quotes the original vague wording, mark it (e.g. 'Original wording: ...') so the lint can tell a resolved quote from live session-dependent text.

design.description: Mutable implementation approach. Required for non-epic, non-blocked beads.

acceptance.description: Outcome-focused, checkable done-conditions. Required (>=1) for a ready feature or bug.

dependencies.description: Typed edges to other beads. Use ONLY these edge types.

metadata.description: Structured, queryable extension data the orchestrator reads at dispatch.

model.description: Execution model. Closed set. Never null on a ready bead.

c4_changes.description: C4 components whose code this bead edits. The wave-collision key.

c4_impacts.description: C4 components affected downstream but not edited.

c4_docs.description: C4 doc files that may need updating as a result of this bead.

allOf.$comment: A ready feature or bug must carry at least one acceptance criterion. blocked-* beads are exempt.
